test_steps: A verifies the C PR exact head, this manifest request hash, and script SHA256; record uploaded script hash and actual tested commit.

A runs python3 -u docs/board-collaboration/BOARD-20261013-A/C/board_error_probe.py --nonce <fresh-A-run-nonce> on the physically connected board; capture stdout, stderr and immediate process exit separately.
Expect exit 1, stdout JSON matching operation BOARD-20261013-A:C:error-feedback-v3 and supplied nonce, and an uncaught RuntimeError with exact marker EXPECTED_C_BOARD_FEEDBACK_BOARD-20261013-A.

A publishes raw logs and SHA256 hashes, real command/environment/nonce, operation ID, request hash and tested commit on this same C PR. C verifies readback after notification. No overlay load or peripheral access is requested.
request.expected_result: Controlled error feedback is observed with exit 1 and the exact RuntimeError traceback. This is expected software-error injection, not a faulty board or performance result. C hardware is not_run until A returns bound board evidence; final acceptance belongs to A.
